messages:
maria_auditor: Hi all — auditor just requested a consolidated evidence packet for SOC 2. Needs: RBAC change history (last 12 months), KMS key rotation proof (cross-region), log retention snapshots (S3/CloudTrail), vuln triage tickets linked to incidents, and IR playbook execution traces. Need by EOD Wed. Thanks!

emma_security: @maria_auditor working on control mapping. Quick Q — do you need proof of automated rotation only, or include manual rotation/change events?

maria_auditor: automated rotation proof preferred, but include manual notes where applicable. Auditor also wants chain-of-custody for any emergency key access.

oliver_sre: I can pull RBAC diffs from infra-repo and export k8s api-server audit logs for the window requested. Will extract rolebinding events and policy changes. ETA ~2h.

liam_ops: For KMS, I'll export key rotation history from CloudTrail + KMS key metadata. Will generate signed snapshot of kms events and provide the S3 object version/hash.

deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded: service/control-plane v1.12.3 — pipeline run 4521 — changelist: 9f8a7c3 (link: https://ci.internal/runs/4521)

emma_security: I'll correlate vuln IDs with our JIRA-SEC tickets and attach triage notes + mitigation evidence. Also include CI/CD deploy audit (pipeline run metadata).

maria_auditor: Can we also provide proof that RBAC changes go through PR review + approver? Auditor picked 2 random role changes to verify.

oliver_sre: Yup — sample commands I'll include in the bundle: `git log --pretty=oneline --grep='rolebinding' --since='2023-03-01'` and an api-server audit query sample. I'll paste trimmed outputs and include the PR links.

liam_ops: AWS CLI snippet for KMS history export I'm using: ```aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventSource,AttributeValue=kms.amazonaws.com --start-time 2023-03-01 --end-time 2024-03-01 > kms-events.json``` Will SHA256 the JSON and upload hash.txt alongside the bundle.

emma_security: For log retention snapshots, I'll pull a time-bounded S3 inventory export + CloudTrail bucket manifest and include Splunk saved search exports. Example Splunk query: `index=redwood cloudtrail (action=UpdateKeyDescription OR action=EnableKeyRotation)`

maria_auditor: Also need a short narrative for each artifact that explains who produced it, how it was collected, and steps to verify (auditor will reproduce).

oliver_sre: I'll bundle RBAC diffs + audit logs and add README.md with collection steps. Will flag entries that correlate to active incidents and include incident links.

liam_ops: FYI — found one emergency key access event on 2023-11-12 that required manual rotation. I'll annotate with the PagerDuty runbook and CSIRT ticket #CSIRT-297 and include signed runbook excerpt.

maria_auditor: Perfect. Once you have bundles, drop them in the secure share: https://files.redwood/soc2/evidence-2024/ — set perms to auditor_jones@external as read-only.

emma_security: Noted — I'll also include a control-mapping matrix (CSV): mapping SOC2 CCs to artifacts (e.g., CC6.1 -> RBAC PRs, CC7.2 -> KMS rotation, CC8.3 -> IR traces).

oliver_sre: ETA on upload ~3.5 hours. Ping me if auditor wants a live walkthrough or screen share.

maria_auditor: Thanks everyone. @oliver_sre @liam_ops @emma_security please ping when uploaded and I'll coordinate the auditor walkthrough. :thumbsup:
